scope: source-derived skill representation; no task result, oracle, verifier or historical solution as router input

input.source_closure: SKILL.md + local scripts/references + explicitly linked local sibling/shared resources; stable source hashes
input.feature_extraction: currently manual source review; future extractor must supply source evidence spans and permit abstention

selection.unit: semantic section, followed by skill-level composition

requires: fields, units, input/output or ID mapping

selection.conflict_resolution: source-supported relation coverage first; choose primary by dominant relation need, not rule order or keyword count; mixed sections can use one auxiliary
selection.confidence: do not invent numerical confidence; unresolved feature conflicts require source review or abstention
abstain: source is contradictory and cannot be rendered without choosing an unsupported interpretation
selection.abstention_output: source-linked compact text/table; preserve the complete original skill

constraints.source_coverage_audit: every extracted atom and relation accounted for across the output, or explicitly listed as omitted; critical constraints may not be silently omitted
constraints.render_budget: freeze canvas area, label count and minimum readable font per matched experiment; thresholds chosen on development material before test
constraints.delivery: one format for all arms in primary ablation; forced every-call replay versus on-demand delivery is a separate experiment

verification: Compare matched-content text, uniform activity, source-matched type and source-mismatched type; evaluate quality before efficiency; test unseen tasks before claiming routing generality.
